verdict.rationale: The pricing page lists a first-party 'Gemini AI assistant in Gmail', and the Workspace updates blog mentions Google Meet 'Take notes for me' settings. Both point to AI assistance built into the product, but neither describes generating insights or suggestions from the user's data. missing for 10: documentation of what Gemini produces from user data (insights, suggestions, analysis), coverage across Workspace apps beyond Gmail/Meet, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: New Google Meet 'Take notes for me' settings for admins and end users take effect September 29th
